content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am working with a [product_name] and am receiving the message: no messages for current charset. I do not understand why this is happening. How can I resolve this issue? Thank you for your help.

Which version of [product_name] are you using? Is it [article_no]? I suspect your program might use Marker27. That marker changes the character set of the [product_name]. Can you modify your program to use a different marker? Please share your program here so we can review it.
Thank you, [user_name], for your reply. I have [article_no], and I do not use Marker27, only M1 to M10 and M17.

Please share your program here so we can review it. It is possible there is a text block in your program set to a new character set. Check each text block in your code: - Right-click the text block and open its properties. - At the bottom, there may be an option to enable a new style—disable this. - At the top of the properties, there may be a 'Use new feature' option—turn this off. This applies mainly to the newer [article_no] series. Alternatively, depending on your [product_name] programming software settings: - Check every text block's properties. - At the top, look for character settings and set it to ISO 8859-1 (Standard). Let us know if this resolves your issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users are experiencing a system message regarding the charset, specifically 'no messages for current charset,' when working with a certain version of [product_name] hardware. The problem appears related to character set configuration or message text block properties, which can be affected by both hardware version and software settings. More detailed guidance on compatibility and correct configuration of character sets is needed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect message displays to function properly without character set errors and seek clear and simple options for configuring the correct character set.
